newsitem.title: UK: Pamela Anderson said to quit Baywatch.
newsitem.headline: Pamela Anderson said to quit Baywatch.

text.p: American actress Pamela Anderson has announced she is quitting the popular television show Baywatch, a British newspaper reported.
Anderson, 29, is to leave the show, which chronicles the adventures of beach lifeguards in California, in order to diversify her career into other areas of show business, the Sun newspaper said.
It said her decision to quit after five years stunned fans and cast alike.
Anderson, 29, made her decision after reaching "crisis point" following the birth of her son Brandon and her split from rock musician husband Tommy Lee, friends said.
The Sun said that in a statement announcing her departure, Anderson praised the show, in which she played the part of lifeguard C.J. Parker.
It said she now wanted to concentrate more on films, children's projects and books.
